includes.comment: OpenPDF AFM metrics for the standard 14 PDF fonts (Helvetica, Courier, Times, Symbol, ZapfDingbats). Type1Font.<init> reads these at runtime to build the font's char-width table; without them, BaseFont.createFont("Helvetica", ...) throws 'No message found for 1.not.found.as.resource'.
CJK font aliases and encoding tables (HeiseiKakuGo, STSong-Light, MSung-Light, etc.) that Type1Font's cjk font lookup needs.
CJK cmap tables used when PDF embeds CJK fonts.
OpenPDF's META-INF/versioned duplicates — keep both module path and META-INF/versions/11/...
Any non-AFM resources in fonts/cmaps/ (CJK cmaps).
OpenPDF's other auxiliary resources (font-fallback, etc.) — keep all to be safe.
OpenPDF's font-fallback mappings used when a glyph is missing.

Adobe glyph name list (e.g. 'A' -> 65, 'aring' -> 0x00E5) used by Type1Font when resolving Unicode codepoints to glyph indices. Without this, text rendering silently drops glyphs (PDF page ends up with empty text).
Additional glyph name lists in META-INF/versions/11/
